pkgmetadata.longdescription: Systems programming language from Mozilla. This binary package provides prebuilt rustc, cargo and the standard library for the x32 ABI (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnux32) in addition to the native amd64 targets.

use.flag: Install rustc source code (used for code completion and building rustc from source)
Install rust-analyzer, an experimental language server for Rust
Makes a prefix installation independent of host locations (use with care)
